references.text: Jesus begins to explain to his disciples that he must suffer and die, but will rise again on the third day, which parallels what he teaches in Mark 9:31.
A similar prediction of Jesus' suffering, death, and resurrection.
Jesus speaks again to his disciples about his coming suffering and death.
The prophecy that Israel will live in God's presence after three days can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' resurrection after three days.
Isaiah's prophecies about the Messiah's suffering and death, which align with Jesus' predictions about his own fate.
